summary: This note is a short biographical entry on James Stokes Millner, a medical practitioner and administrator who played a role in the early history of the Northern Territory of Australia. It gives his dates as 1830 to 25 February 1875. The note is brief and contains no further details about his career.
one_line: James Stokes Millner (1830–1875) was a doctor and administrator in the early history of Australia's Northern Territory.
key_facts: James Stokes Millner held the degree of MD.
James Stokes Millner was born in 1830.
James Stokes Millner died on 25 February 1875.
James Stokes Millner was a medical practitioner.
James Stokes Millner was an administrator.
James Stokes Millner was active in the early history of the Northern Territory of Australia.
